summary: Phase 1 pivot verification (2nd testing pass): 34/34 fast backend pytest tests PASS (waitlist + analytics + admin stats/waitlist/analytics + billing stub + existing regression). All 4 Playwright frontend flows PASS: landing page_view + hero cta_click analytics events fire, waitlist submission shows success card with position + duplicate email shows 'Already on the list' variant, pricing plan CTAs route to /#waitlist and fire pricing_cta_click, admin panel Overview/Waitlist/Analytics tabs switch via ?tab= URL param, admin waitlist table shows 8 rows with working search + copy + CSV, analytics tab renders both recharts (BarChart events-by-type + LineChart daily activity). Mobile responsiveness at 390px verified: no horizontal scroll on landing, hero title reads 'Turn a topic into a cinematic video.', CTAs are full-width, pricing plans stack in single column, admin sidebar has display:none while tab bar remains visible.

minor.issue: Email validation is minimal ('@' and '.' substrings only). 'a@b.c' passes but 'foo@bar' fails. Not a bug per spec but consider Pydantic EmailStr for stricter check.
No auth / rate-limit. Anyone can flood analytics_events. Fine for MVP validation, but a bot could inflate metrics.
by_day items include per-event breakdown; frontend groups them client-side in groupByDay(). Consider server-side aggregation to keep payload small once event volume grows.

integration_issues.issue: Fires twice on initial mount (visible in captured network log). Most likely React 18 StrictMode double-mount in dev. Harmless for admin metrics because it only inflates counts in dev, but confirm StrictMode is disabled or effect uses a ref-guard in production build.

action_items: OPTIONAL: guard the page_view useEffect with a ref (e.g., useRef+didFire) so it fires exactly once even under React 18 StrictMode double-mount (currently emits 2 page_view events per landing load in dev).
OPTIONAL: use Pydantic EmailStr on WaitlistIn.email for stricter validation.
OPTIONAL: add basic rate limiting (per-IP) to /api/analytics/track to prevent event flooding.
critical_code_review_comments: billing.py checkout & webhook return raw HTTPException(501) — that's fine as a stub but consider a JSON body {"error":"not_enabled"} for future client consumption.
server.py: /api/waitlist stores IP + user-agent in Mongo. If the app ever ships to EU users, ensure a privacy policy exists (GDPR).
server.py: analytics_events collection has no TTL/index — will grow unbounded. Add {created_at: 1} index (asc) and consider a TTL for retention.

AdminPanel.jsx: loads /admin/stats, /admin/waitlist, /admin/analytics in parallel on every mount but never refetches on tab change — acceptable, but adding a subtle refresh button/interval would keep numbers fresh during a demo.

AdminPanel.jsx groupByDay drops the per-event dimension — the LineChart currently plots the SUM of all events per day (not per-event lines). Chart title 'Daily activity' is accurate, but a multi-series line by event would surface signal better; consider Recharts <Line dataKey=...> per event.
Landing.jsx page_view effect: no dependency guard against StrictMode double-mount — fires 2× locally.
server.py: analytics_events.created_at is stored as ISO string; range queries on ISO strings work by lexicographic order but a real BSON Date would be safer and index-friendlier.
